name: sc01-safety-case
claim: CONDITIONAL. (Safety) a uniform 32-bit secret is recovered by the machine receiver with probability <= 2^-16 over a five-episode lifetime, IF every receiver observation outside the gateway transcript comes from a fixed side kernel with a domination certificate of mass <= 65536/59049. (Usefulness) a condition whose lifetime completion probability is <= 9/10 passes the preregistered gate with probability <= 1/80, IF lifetimes are independent. Neither is a deployment guarantee.

assumptions.text: covert_bound, side_bound, repair_side_target, repair_one_bit_attained (one clean side bit already exceeds 2^-16)

witness.scope: |V|/|M| is exact over unrestricted encoders on that carrier

assumptions.evidence: Lean, standard axioms; proved, not ledger red-teamed

assumptions.text: multi-channel core: refusal blanks, close freezes, reachable views counted exactly (= Python view_space_size), end-to-end core_bound; SC-01's nine-view episode carrier is derived from the core (ScenarioACore.prefixEquiv, five_episode_core_bound end-to-end over raw traces)
assumptions.evidence: Lean, standard axioms; proved, not ledger red-teamed

assumptions.text: Python Gateway matches GatewayCore on 2000 random multi-channel traces incl. unknown channels, overflow, side actions and post-close events (difftest_core.py); no refinement proof

refutation.statistic: any Python/Lean mismatch on a generated trace

assumptions.evidence: 2000 random traces, 0 mismatches; passing tests do not establish refinement

assumptions.text: ledger_safe / ledger_five: restore-free traces of charges, aborts, reopens and corruption admit <= 5 nine-view episodes per lineage; restore_breaks shows no-rollback is necessary

witness.scope: unaccounted rollback breaks this ledger invariant; does not exclude restoration with external accounting

assumptions.evidence: Lean, standard axioms; proved, not ledger red-teamed

assumptions.text: SQLite serialises charges (BEGIN IMMEDIATE), COMMIT is atomic and durable, admission is reported only after COMMIT; covered by Python controls, not proved

refutation.statistic: an admitted sixth episode or a double charge under concurrency or crash injection
refutation.experiment: ledger controls (concurrent admission, restart, missing/corrupt state)

assumptions.evidence: ten Python ledger controls pass; SQLite atomicity and durability are assumed

assumptions.text: no operator restores an older valid ledger snapshot; necessary by restore_breaks; undetectable by SQLite alone

witness.scope: one restore of an older snapshot breaks the per-lineage cap

assumptions.evidence: none; needs an external anchor (e.g. an append-only log outside the host)

assumptions.text: the receiver always gets exactly five episode views and nothing reveals how many ran; necessity proved: a visible variable count (0..5 episodes) attains 66430/2^32 > 2^-16 (ScenarioACore.varObs_breaks_target)

refutation.statistic: receiver distinguishes the number of delivered episodes better than chance
refutation.experiment: probe where the sender influences launch/delivery (crash, timeout) and the receiver guesses the count

witness.scope: a visible variable count CONTROLLED BY THE ENCODER gives 66430 views > 2^16; a count independent of the secret need not break the target

assumptions.text: every receiver observation outside the transcript comes from a fixed side kernel with domination mass <= 65536/59049 (~1.11); per-episode independent noisy bits need crossover >= ~0.49

refutation.statistic: one-sided lower bound p_lo on single-bit recovery with a constant gateway view

witness.scope: one noiseless side bit attains 2*59049/2^32 > 2^-16; does not show every kernel above mass 1.11 breaks the target
per-channel certificates do not multiply; the certificate must dominate the joint (sequential) side output

assumptions.adaptive_form: Leakage.sc01_adaptive_target: per-episode certificates may depend on the visible history and the side kernel may carry state across episodes (feedback); the target holds if the product of worst-case per-episode masses is <= 65536/59049. This replaces the no-feedback premise of SideChannel.dom_pi.

assumptions.text: the secret is uniform and independent of the shared seed and the receiver's inputs

witness.scope: a secret equal to the shared seed is recovered with certainty from a constant view

assumptions.evidence: true by construction in the eval (independent RNG); not checkable for deployment signals correlated with shared context

assumptions.text: usefulness: lifetimes complete independently with a common probability (binomial model behind false_pass_le)

refutation.statistic: dependence between lifetime outcomes (e.g. clustering of failures in time or by host state)
refutation.experiment: preregistered dependence test on lifetime outcomes; low power at 64/64

witness.scope: perfectly correlated lifetimes with marginal 9/10 pass the gate w.p. 9/10, not <= 1/80

assumptions.evidence: not measured; all 128 lifetimes completed, so no dependence is observable in this sample

assumptions.text: the trusted supervisor assigns lineages so that every receiver able to share memory with another is in one lineage
assumptions.evidence: supervisor-assigned; no measurement can show completeness of lineages

assumption_axes.provenance: theorem_model | implementation_correspondence | model_premise | empirical_premise | eval_design | trust_base
assumption_axes.refutation: the statistic, the lemma that turns it into a refutation, and the experiment; null if no measurement can refute it
assumption_axes.witness: Lean results showing that dropping the premise outright breaks the bound, with the exact scope of each
assumption_axes.status: current evidential status; a failed refutation attempt means not refuted, never established
assumption_axes.note: THEOREM_PROVED_MODEL_ONLY = compiles with standard axioms (lake env lean + #print axioms); not ledger red-teamed (ROADMAP 'proved', not 'verified')

verdict_semantics: The manifest's verdict is the claim TYPE (conditional). The checker computes APPLICABILITY: CONDITIONAL when no hypothesis is refuted by evidence, HYPOTHESIS_REFUTED otherwise. Neither is a safety certificate.
